name: Drutopia Storyline
description: Drutopia feature that provides two Storyline Paragraphs types (a header and repeatable items) plus a node entity-reference-revisions field, for building a simple chronology or timeline of content.
project_description: Drutopia Storyline is a configuration-only Drutopia feature module. It ships two Paragraphs bundles — storyline_header (one text field) and storyline_item (a heading plus a long-text body, grouped by a Field Group) — together with their form and view displays, and a multi-value entity_reference_revisions field field_storyline on the node entity type for holding a sequence of those paragraphs. Combined they let editors build a simple chronology or timeline of content. There is no PHP: no src/, no .module or .install, no routes, permissions, services, config schema, or Drush commands. The project directory also bundles a companion sub-feature, drutopia_page_storyline, that attaches field_storyline to the Basic page content type; per campaign scope that companion is treated as a separate project and documented elsewhere, not here. As shipped on disk this is a dev checkout (info.yml carries no version).
